answer: Someone running 119 aliases hence needs 49 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in echo, expire in atlas, and forge lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1254 identities would post 3215 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
